priority_items.title: SCS CoC: Lazaro says ~80% of text provisionally agreed; no conclusion yet
priority_items.summary: FACT (CNA 6553056, 15 Nov 22:41+08): PHL FS Lazaro — ASEAN and China reached provisional agreement on about 80% of the CoC negotiating text. Quote: “Definitely, there is no conclusion yet.” Chair-year lift ~50%→~80%; nine rounds + two SOMs; MYS+CHN co-chair. DOC relationship provisionally agreed; code is to manage differences, not settle claims. CLAIM (Lazaro): another 5–6 months; SGP 2027 to finish. PNA Marcos 03:17:18Z and PNA lawmakers 05:53:08Z restate ~80%. Not a concluded/binding code.

priority_items.title: 5PC Review and Decision issued; gradual-restoration language is CNA-quoted, PDF unpublished
priority_items.summary: FACT (PNA 23:12:22Z): leaders publicly issued an ASEAN Leaders’ Review and Decision on the Implementation of the Five-Point Consensus among ≥150 documents. CLAIM (CNA 6552716 quoting joint decision): ASEAN may consider gradual restoration of Myanmar’s full political representation subject to sustained 5PC progress; bilateral outreach encouraged in consultation with the Chair. FACT: MAH still barred; DG Han Win Aung represented MMR. AMM Lazaro “no easing” held. asean.org 307.

priority_items.title: Kasandigan PHL–AUS leaders’ statement posts; DCA PDF still unpublished
priority_items.summary: FACT (pm.gov.au 16 Nov, lm 07:40:11 GMT): Marcos–Albanese Kasandigan statement names the Defence Cooperation Arrangement signed 15 Nov (0547) and lists MDA, littoral, logistics, cyber, joint planning, force protection, defence infrastructure. Contingency consultations; SCS coercive-action concern; 2016 Award final and binding; continue SCS maritime cooperative activities. No access/basing verbs. ASEAN–Australia CSP-5 joint leaders’ statement also issued (lm 07:23:08 GMT). PRC MFA latest still 13 Nov Mao Ning.

priority_items.title: Wong: ACAFTA 3.0 EIF next month; ASEAN–China digital/AI 2027 proposal
priority_items.summary: FACT (CNA 6553926, 16 Nov 12:51+08): PM Wong at 29th ASEAN–China Summit (Li Qiang present) — DEFA as digital-connectivity hook; welcomes PRC proposal to designate 2027 Year of ASEAN–China AI Cooperation; ACAFTA 3.0 Upgrade protocol “entering into force next month”; calls for expeditious CoC consistent with UNCLOS. Li CLAIM (PNA): two-way trade >USD 1tn last year. Gazette/depositary unpublished.

priority_items.title: Prabowo apologises to SGP/MYS on haze; sensors still Moderate/Good — not FLASH
priority_items.summary: FACT (CNA 6553166): Prabowo apologised 15 Nov for transboundary haze. CLAIM: 16 firefighters dead, 2 helicopters lost, 104 firms under investigation, 17 concessions revoked. Wong proposed expanding the IDN–SGP company task force ASEAN-wide. Lazaro: leaders encouraged ACC THPC ratification. 15:00 SGT PSI max W55 Moderate; APIMS 0 Unhealthy max 61.
